archive_path_normalization: External artifact lookup paths are represented by snapshot identifier and relative path. Raw logs and original compile manifests remain unmodified outside the repository; their original hashes are pinned. Race-stack extracts replace only frozen-source and Go-installation path prefixes, preserving line numbers and stack text.
comparison: Same frozen combined-v3 core plus identical new test files. After adds only the fresh cumulative rate field/qualification, final pacing calculation, and absent-service fallback helper hunk.
scope: Nine explicit-clock roots. Fresh fully-qualified cumulative delivery advances and lowers cold pacing; a single reply, tiny control traffic, missing/stale history and an old permission epoch cannot provide a new rate. Positive slow service and hard target/byte bounds remain authoritative. Carrier attribution is separately tightened and tested in the scope-v2 archive.
